title: RenderRequest
description: What the app sends to the render HTTP service. The service compiles (nagma + bpm + sa -> ExpressiveScore) then renders a looping WAV. The tuple (nagma_hash, bpm, sa, instrument, avartans, seed) is the cache key on both client and server.

nagma_text.description: The raw text-grammar nagma. One of nagma_text or nagma must be provided.

nagma.description: A pre-parsed NagmaDoc. One of nagma_text or nagma must be provided.

sa.description: Tonic key name, e.g. 'C#', 'D'. Mapped to a MIDI note by core.

seed.description: Base seed for per-avartan expressive variation. Same inputs + same seed => byte-identical render (cacheable).

laya.description: Override the laya realization. null (default) auto-selects from bpm: <=85 vilambit, 86-160 madhya, >160 drut. The user authors the vilambit; faster layas are derived by reduction.
